body.objective: Students will be able to ask where places are with 在.
body.iCan: I can ask where places are with 在.
successCriteria: I can ask where places are with 在哪儿
I can say where places are using location words
I can describe locations in my school or neighbourhood
body.hook: 洗手间在哪儿? "Where's the washroom?" is one of the most useful questions any traveller can ask. In Mandarin, 在 zài tells you where something is.

study.title: 在哪儿?
study.question: How do I ask and say where places are in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Grammar (written for this lesson):
Place + 在 + location: 图书馆在哪儿? Túshūguǎn zài nǎr? (Where is the library?) 图书馆在食堂旁边。(The library is next to the cafeteria.)
Location words often follow a noun: 学校前边 (in front of the school), 银行对面 (across from the bank), 教室里边 (inside the classroom), 商店后边 (behind the store).
Places: 学校 xuéxiào school, 图书馆 túshūguǎn library, 食堂 shítáng cafeteria, 体育馆 tǐyùguǎn gym, 医院 yīyuàn hospital, 银行 yínháng bank, 商店 shāngdiàn store, 公园 gōngyuán park, 饭馆 fànguǎn restaurant.
Polite: 请问 qǐngwèn (excuse me, may I ask): 请问, 洗手间在哪儿?
Note: in some regions people say 哪里 nǎlǐ instead of 哪儿 nǎr.
Activity: label a school map in Mandarin, then partners ask 请问, …在哪儿? and answer with location words.
study.source: Original activity written for this lesson.
steps: Ask and answer with a school map
discussion: Where does the location word go?
What's the difference between 哪儿 and 哪里?
Where is the gym in your school?

body.objective: Students will be able to give directions.
successCriteria: I can give directions with 往, 拐 and 一直走

body.hook: You're lost in Beijing and someone says "一直走, 到红绿灯往左拐." Would you know where to go? Giving and following directions is a key travel skill.

study.title: 怎么走?
study.question: How do I give and follow directions in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Directions (written for this lesson):
Asking: 请问, 去图书馆怎么走? Qǐngwèn, qù túshūguǎn zěnme zǒu? (Excuse me, how do I get to the library?) 远不远? (Is it far?)
Giving: 一直走。(Go straight.) 到红绿灯往左拐。(At the traffic lights turn left.) 在第二个路口往右拐。(Turn right at the second intersection.) 图书馆在右边。(The library is on the right.)
Distance: 医院离这儿很近。(The hospital is very near here.) 公园离学校很远。(The park is far from school.)
Dialogue:
A: 请问, 去火车站怎么走?
B: 一直走, 到第二个路口往右拐。火车站在银行对面。
A: 远不远?
B: 不远, 走路十分钟。
A: 谢谢!
B: 不客气。
Activity: with a town map, one partner gives directions from the school to a secret place; the other traces the route and names the destination.
study.source: Original dialogue and activity written for this lesson.
discussion: How do you ask how to get somewhere?
What does 到红绿灯往左拐 mean?
Did your partner find the secret place?
study.product: Write directions in Mandarin from your school to three places on a map, using 一直走, 往左拐/往右拐, 到 and 离.

body.objective: Students will be able to talk about transportation.
successCriteria: I can name kinds of transportation in Mandarin
I can say how I travel with 坐, 骑 and 开
I can compare travel times and choices
body.hook: China's high-speed rail network is the longest in the world, and trains between Beijing and Shanghai can take about four and a half hours for a trip of over 1,000 km. How do you get around?

vocabulary.definition: to ride, take (a vehicle you sit in)

study.title: 怎么去?
study.question: How do I talk about transportation in Mandarin?
study.passage:
Grammar (written for this lesson):
坐 zuò + vehicle you sit in: 坐公共汽车, 坐地铁, 坐飞机, 坐火车, 坐高铁, 坐出租车 (taxi).
骑 qí + vehicle you straddle: 骑自行车 (bike), 骑马 (horse).
开车 kāi chē: to drive. 走路 zǒulù: to walk.
How you go: subject + how + 去 + place: 我坐公共汽车去学校。(I go to school by bus.) 我爸爸开车去上班。(My dad drives to work.)
Question: 你怎么去学校? Nǐ zěnme qù xuéxiào? (How do you get to school?)
Time: 坐地铁要二十分钟。(It takes 20 minutes by subway.)
Facts: China has the world's largest high-speed rail network; the fastest Beijing–Shanghai trains take around four and a half hours. Many Chinese cities have large subway systems; bike-sharing is common. In Alberta, Calgary has the CTrain and Edmonton has the LRT.
Activity: class survey 你怎么去学校? 要多长时间? Then make a bar chart labelled in Mandarin.
study.source: Original activity written for this lesson; transport facts are general and from public sources.
steps: Use 坐, 骑 and 开
discussion: Why is it 坐 for buses but 骑 for bikes?
